senses.sense_definition: Zonder meetbare diepte of bodem, vaak figuurlijk gebruikt voor emoties of situaties.

examples.text: Na het overlijden van zijn vrouw kwam de man in een <w>peilloze</w> depressie terecht.

target_lang_translations.en: After the death of his wife, the man fell into a <w>bottomless</w> depression.

examples.text: De wetenschappers staarden in de <w>peilloze</w> diepte van de oceaan.

target_lang_translations.en: The scientists stared into the <w>unfathomable</w> depths of the ocean.

target_lang_definitions.en: Without measurable depth or bottom; often used figuratively to describe extreme emotions or situations.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Used for both physical depth and figurative situations.
Used for extreme depth or emotions that are impossible to fully understand or measure.
Used primarily for extreme physical depths, such as the ocean.
